meta.name: Gun line standard (GUN_BUILDING_STUDY 5, 3.1, 3.7, 5.8, 7)
meta.rule: one file for what every gun of the line shares; a gun's spec overrides a value only with a recorded resolution. Written for gunlib 0.2.0 (SMG_BUILD_PLAN 15 W1a); the AR-01 values it carries are the ones the pilot shipped with
meta.units: millimetres and degrees unless a key says otherwise

frame.axes: Blender metres, modelled in mm; +X = muzzle (bore parallel to X at Y = 0), +Z up, -Y = the gun's right side
frame.unreal_mapping: Unreal cm = (Bx, -By, Bz) / 10; Unreal +X forward, +Y right, +Z up
frame.origin: Grip: on the grip's centre axis in Y = 0, grip_origin_depth_mm down that axis from the web line
frame.grip_origin_depth_source: AR-01 H1 early (the fit body's palm centre on the knuckle line; study 5.1 provisional 40 replaced)
frame.blender_front_view: from -Y shows the right side, muzzle to screen right

bones.rule: lowercase snake, no dots; every bone deforms except 'magazine' (attach only, no weighted vertices); rest rotation = root's (identity); the armature OBJECT is 'root' at Grip (no bone named root); missing bones omitted, never dummies; same bones on every LOD
bones.abp: one ABP_Gun_<Class> on the class pilot; later guns list the pilot as a Compatible Skeleton; normalized inputs (bolt 0..1, trigger pull 0..1, selector detent index, release 0..1) mapped per gun by the sidecar's gun.abp_angle_table

sockets.rule: PascalCase; on bones in the skeletal sidecar; Empties + .sockets.json on the statics

SupportHand.place: off-hand palm centre: handguard (long guns), magwell (SMG), support wrap (pistol); +X along the bore

Muzzle.place: bore exit, +X out of the bore

MuzzleSeat.place: barrel shoulder where devices seat, +X forward

Sight.place: on the sight line at the rear notch / aperture, +X toward the front sight

Mag.place: the mag's origin frame when seated

MagRockStart.place: rock-in mags only: the rock's start frame

Rail_Top.place: centre of slot 0 (rearmost) on the rail-top plane, +X along the slots, +Z out of the rail

Stock.place: stock interface (tube end or hinge face)

Holster.place: point the gun hangs from when stowed

magazine_interface.origin: the seating pivot; +X forward, +Z out of the well along the final insertion direction
magazine_interface.straight: the centre of the well-entry opening; insertion along -Z from MagInsertStart (lerp)
magazine_interface.rock_in: the front-lug hook point; MagInsertStart -> (lerp) -> MagRockStart -> (slerp about the lug) -> Mag
magazine_interface.lod_screen_sizes: derived: size_mag = size_gun x r_mag / r_gun (measured engine-equivalent bounds)

rail_1913.authority: MIL-STD-1913 (3 Feb 1995) Figure 1 'Accessory mounting rail profile' (inches) via Wikimedia Commons M1913A_Rail_CrossSection.svg; slot numbers also Wikipedia 'Picatinny rail'

drawing_in.gauge_width_C: 0.748 +-0.002 (on the 45 deg flanks, at two lines 0.108 basic apart)
drawing_in.flanks: 2x 45 deg above and below the V

derived_mm.note: 45 deg flanks through the gauge width at both gauge lines; the lower gauge line 4.10 below the top (0.1614 in, inside 0.144-0.164) puts the V face's lower end exactly at the 3.00 slot floor, so the slot floor meets the V face's edge with no sliver (UD2)

lods.LOD1: every slot, half the bevel segments
lods.LOD2: trapezoid section (no undercut), teeth as plain blocks

rail_1913.snap: an attachment's Mount at Rail_X + k x slot_pitch along +X, integer k

clearance_mm.why_butt_never_exact: qa_check no_coincident_vertices fails any vertex pair within 1e-6 m across the joined twin; 0.01 mm is 10x that

M-chamfer.what: machined broken edge: barrel, blocks, bolt, rails, slide

M-round.what: machined radius: sight ears, slide top

P-round.what: moulded polymer: SMG body, grips, stocks; parting line, sink at thick ribs, ejector circles on hidden faces

hardware.rule: count and position from the sheet only; sizes from these norms where a head spans < 4 sheet px; written in mm, never 'M' + number (study 3.2, spec fastener_rule)
hardware.roll_pin: split tube: wall 0.2 x dia, slit 0.2 x dia, ends chamfered
real_pattern_sources: ISO 7380-1 button head hexagon socket screws: dk 1.9 d, k 0.55 d, s 0.6-0.67 d, t ~0.31 d (M5: 9.5 / 2.75 / 3 / 1.56) https://fasten.it/en/norms/norm/din_en_iso_7380-1 , https://engineersedge.com/iso_socket_button_head.htm
ISO 4762 socket head cap screws: dk 1.5 d, k 1.0 d, s 0.75-0.8 d, t ~0.5 d (M5: 8.5 / 5 / 4 / 2.5) https://fasten.it/norms/norm/din_en_iso_4762
ISO 10642 countersunk hexagon socket: 90 deg head, dk 1.9-2.2 d (M5 9.43 actual min, 11.2 theoretical), s 0.6 d https://engineersedge.com/hardware/bs_en_iso_10642_14583.htm
ISO 8752 slotted spring (roll) pins: wall ~0.2 d

lod_pop.rule: d = 1.778 r / s (Unreal's 2 max(0.5 P00, 0.5 P11) r / d at 16:9, 90 deg)

A.what: rear sight leaf / aperture, optic eyepiece, front post and hood (ADS 55 deg at 0.20-0.25 m)

B.what: rear receiver, dust cover, selector, charging handle, grip top, comb

C.what: mag, magwell, trigger guard, handguards, front receiver

D.what: gas block, front sight base, barrel, brake

E.what: hidden: undersides, insides, contact faces (reload-visible insides at the low end)

unreal_degenerate_rule.rule: every part generator checks its own output at every LOD before the part is accepted; export meshes are never patched (tspace.unreal_safe stays diagnostic)

deny_list: Scripts/guns/gunlib/qa_gun.py GUN_DENY (tokenised; whole runs of tokens only)
